title: Work order card: line search, completing, invoiced and no-schedule cases
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Open Customers, open customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' (create it if missing), open its Assets tab and open unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' (create it with New Asset if missing). Open the asset's Maintenance tab. If the unit is not on the schedule, press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', enter a last service date for PM-A about seven months ago (for example 6 Mar 2026) and press Enroll. PM-A now reads Overdue on the Maintenance tab.
  4. On the customer page press New Work Order, choose unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and create the work order (it opens as an estimate). Note its number, for example S3780-15904.
  5. On the work order page, find the Maintenance schedule card inside the asset card at the top and press Expand.
  6. Have a second work order for the unit that is already invoiced (Finance > Create Invoice, payment recorded).
  7. For steps 4 and 5, create two new test organizations yourself on the QA build, the way you normally create a test organization, and sign in to each as its Owner/Admin:
  8. Organization A, e.g. 'ZZAUTOTEST No Schedule Org': create nothing in Settings > Maintenance, so it has no maintenance schedule. Add a customer and a unit (Customers, New Customer, then New Asset) and create one work order for that unit (New Work Order).
  9. Organization B, e.g. 'ZZAUTOTEST One Location Org': keep the single location it starts with and add no other. In Settings > Maintenance create the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM' with service 'PM-A' exactly as above (Calendar trigger Every 6 months, the same four canned lines, which you first create under that location's canned lines). Add customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' and unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402', enroll the unit with a PM-A last service date about seven months ago so PM-A reads Overdue, and create one work order for it.
custom_steps:
1. On the open work order press New Line and search for 'PM-A'; read what the search returns.
  2. Expand the Maintenance schedule card and try to complete the work order (Complete work order) with PM-A still due.
  3. Open the invoiced work order, expand the card and read the PM-A row: look for Add Service, hover the (i), and open the three-dot menu.
  4. In the organization with no schedule open any work order and look for a Maintenance schedule card.
  5. In the organization with one workplace add a service from the card and check the lines were not copied.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Line search returns canned lines only, never the maintenance service PM-A.
  • Nothing in the card blocks completing the work order.
  • On the invoiced work order there is no Add Service (in the design the row shows Lines can’t be created here); its (i) reads Lines can't be created on an invoiced work order, and Mark complete is still in the row's menu.
  • The organization with no maintenance schedule shows no maintenance card on a work order.
  • The organization with one workplace never copies work: every work order is at the home location, so the lines are the schedule's own.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S16; Design MR_V2_2 (Claude Design export, 6 Oct 2026), driven in full on 6 Oct 2026, Chunk 2 board artboard W7i; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-N2: “Line search does not return maintenance services. Adding a line returns canned lines only”
  • S16-N3: “Nothing in the panel blocks closing the work order”
  • S16-N7: “Add Service is not offered on a work order that is invoiced or paid, because adding lines there would void or reopen its invoice. The row's (i) reads Lines can't be created on an invoiced work order, and Mark complete stays in its menu”
  • S16-N8: “An organization with no maintenance schedule sees no maintenance card on a work order”
  • S16-N9: “An organization with one workplace never copies work. Every work order is at the home location”
  • Design, Chunk 2 board, artboard W7i, row control on an invoiced work order: “Lines can’t be created here”
